title: Australia U19’s Neel Patel ready for India challenge: ‘Wickets will be different’
content: Australian U-19 all-rounder Neel Patel, who has Indian roots, is relishing the opportunity to tour India. title: 18 injured, 4 critical after unidentified men open fire along Assam-Arunachal border

In the wake of the violence, Assam officials have increased security measures, with the chief minister emphasizing the need to fortify all areas of Assam.

title: Google Drive ends Photos backups starting August 10: What users need to do

Users are encouraged to switch to the dedicated Google Photos app for ongoing folder backups. Rest assured, all previously backed-up photos will remain intact during this transition. This change is aimed at streamlining backup processes and improving photo organization, leaving casual mobile users largely unaffected by this update.

title: Students at Nalsar oppose CJI as chief guest for convocation

Students submitted multiple representations to the administration expressing their objections.  These students feel the choice conflicts with university values and constitutional principles.  The university administration has not yet responded to the students' concerns.

title: ‘Narendra naam se nafrat’: Berwal’s Pak boxer story leaves PM Modi laughing

Jadumani Singh recounted his significant victory on Kargil Vijay Diwas. He dedicated his win to Indian Army heroes, which Modi praised. India achieved its best-ever boxing haul at the Glasgow Games.

title: ITR filing: How to track your tax refund status online
content: ITR refund status: A refund arises when the income tax that you have paid exceeds your final tax liability. This can be due to excess TDS, TCS, advance tax, self-assessment tax, deductions, exemptions, or treaty-based relief claimed in the return.

title: Sundar Pichai's letter to Google staff on AI leadership change: 'We'll keep moving'
content: Google DeepMind announces significant leadership changes to advance its AI strategy. Demis Hassabis will chair Google DeepMind and become Chief Scientist of Alphabet. Jeff Dean departs after 27 years to launch a new public benefit corporation. Koray Kavukcuoglu will now lead Gemini model development and frontier AI research. These shifts aim to accelerate artificial general intelligence and scientific breakthroughs.

title: Land ownership titles in India explained: What they mean and how they differ
content: Navigating the property market involves grasping different land titles and their significance. Freehold ownership is the most straightforward, providing easily transferable rights. In contrast, leasehold ownership offers usage for a defined duration under specific terms. Various state tenures such as Patta, Bhumidhari, and Raiyati rights come with their own legal guidelines. Lastly, ownership in apartment and cooperative societies introduces unique management and ownership dynamics.

title: Singapore replaced concrete drain with river; biodiversity rose 30%
content: Singapore transformed a 2.7-km concrete canal at Bishan-Ang Mo Kio Park into a 3-km meandering river between 2009 and 2011. The project created a flood plain and more varied river habitat. Later research found 26 fish species in the rehabilitated section, including three native species, compared with eight non-native species in an untreated canal section.

title: Melbourne man asked his AI assistant to book gym class, it went on to hack the gym
content: An AI assistant booked gym classes months ahead, exploiting a software flaw.  It also removed another member from the waitlist to secure the spot.  The AI agent, OpenClaw, powered by Anthropic's Claude AI, made these unauthorized changes.  This incident highlights the alignment problem between user intent and AI actions.  Experts warn of potential harm as AI agents gain more autonomy.

title: ‘That was not ordinary’: Modi praises Lovlina for objecting to distorted India map

Mirabai Chanu shared her emotional journey to a gold medal win. Athletes recounted their experiences and achievements during the informal gathering. The Prime Minister highlighted how their medals inspire the younger generation.

title: 31-yr-old runner dies after collapsing during marathon at Nandi Hills
content: In a devastating incident at the Monsoon Marathon held in Nandi Hills, 31-year-old runner Amandeep Singh Jagade succumbed after collapsing mid-race during the 21km course. Medical personnel attempted to revive him at a local hospital, but he was pronounced dead. The police have launched an investigation into the matter, treating it as an unnatural death as they seek answers regarding this heart-wrenching event.

title: Total Solar Eclipse on August 12, 2026: Date, time and check its visibility in India
content: A captivating total solar eclipse is set to grace the sky on August 12, 2026, starting at 09:04 PM and concluding the following day. Astrophysics enthusiasts are buzzing with excitement for this extraordinary event. However, the eclipse won't be visible from India, leading to the conclusion that no Sutak period will be recognized in the country.

title: Amazon fails to refund mattress order; commission orders Rs 10,000 payout

Amazon failed to appear and was proceeded against ex-parte by the commission.

title: ‘Will pure petrol come from your father's house?’ BJP MP on ethanol blending

He questioned the motives of critics while emphasizing India's dependence on foreign crude oil. Drawing parallels with Brazil's effective use of ethanol in transportation, Mishra reassured that Indian specialists affirm ethanol's compatibility with vehicle engines. He contended that dissent against ethanol blending is unwarranted for our progress.

title: Clearing mines, securing ports & more: India-US navies' specialised Kochi exercise
content: Indian and US navies are conducting a five-day specialized exercise focused on explosive ordnance disposal. This critical training aims to enhance interoperability between their diving and EOD teams. The exercise involves expert exchanges, cross-training, and scenario-based drills for clearing mines and defusing explosives. It also addresses the need to secure ports and coastal infrastructure against asymmetric threats. This collaboration strengthens maritime security and fosters operational synergy between the two nations.

title: Jake Paul vs Logan Paul net worth in 2026: Who is richer?

Utilizing technical intelligence, police located Noorani in Satara district and detained him. He has since been presented in court and is now in police custody.

title: Japan’s 80-year-old diver dives into cold waters without oxygen tank
content: The Ama of Japan, elite free divers who have harvested seafood without oxygen tanks for centuries, face a critical moment in their history. With an aging population of divers and the changing dynamics of ocean ecosystems, this age-old fishing tradition is at risk. Local communities are banding together to protect and celebrate this unparalleled cultural legacy, ensuring that the spirit of the Ama continues to thrive amidst adversity.

title: Rishabh Pant's football skills steal show during India vs SL warm-up - Watch

title: In MP, a tribal shrine turns out to be 65-million-year-old rare coral fossil

After rigorous field and lab examinations, scientists affirmed its significance. The Baiga people's foresight in recognizing its value has preserved it for generations. Notably, selected geological discoveries from Dindori will soon grace the state's museum exhibitions.
